bio.text: Elgie Sims Jr., a Democrat, represents the 17th District in the Illinois Senate, which covers parts of Chicago's South Side, the south suburbs, and Will and Kankakee counties.
According to his office biography, he previously served nearly four terms as state representative for the 34th House District and was budget director for the Senate Democrats.

The biography says he was born in Chicago, holds a B.A. in political science from Illinois State University, an M.P.A. from the University of Illinois and a J.D. from Loyola University Chicago School of Law, and is an attorney.
